episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: On the way to school, Xu Jingjing encountered a 200-pound male fatty at a breakfast stand she frequently visits. They both got into a tussle for a seat, which resulted in the breakfast stand's sign getting stuck to their pants. With school about to start, they had no choice but to head towards the school while grumbling at each other. The fatty turned out to be Kang Jiawei, the new transfer student in Xu Jingjing's class, Class 3, introduced by the homeroom teacher, Chen Bei. He was a regular participant in various city competitions and a well-known top student. Soon after, the midterm exam results were out, and Xu Jingjing, the underachiever, once again secured the last place in the class.

translations.title: 我的卡路里男孩
translations.overview: 许晶晶，一个会跆拳道的少女战士，康家伟，一个除子胖什么都好的学霸转校生，因为不想再当没人搭理的死胖子，因为不想再做仰视男神的小透明，而决定互帮互助，改造彼此。康家伟帮许晶晶补课刷题，许晶晶带康家伟减肥消脂，两个人互相陪伴，彼此“虚待”，经历了期中冤考、情书寻找、寒假失踪各种冷战绝交等一系列沟沟坎坎后，两人逆袭成功，但却发现，喜欢的对象早就不是男神女神，而变成了彼此。他们在十七岁这年，因为彼此的存在，大哭大笑，大喊大叫，尽情地挥霍了他们独一无二的青春，懂得了什么才是真正的喜欢——不是偶像式崇拜，不是遥远的懂课。而是两颗有趣的灵魂火星撞地球般的相遇。
